items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Mary Hill?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses and 4 condos and townhomes listed in Mary Hill. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Mary Hill a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 21% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Mary Hill from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses and 2 condos and townhomes sold in Mary Hill over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Mary Hill compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Mary Hill held 9.2% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 1.8% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Mary Hill?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 77.8% of the 18 homes listed in Mary Hill and condos and townhomes made up 22.2%; of the 3 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Mary Hill than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses held from 14 to 14 (+0.0%) and condos and townhomes held from 4 to 4 (+0.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
